description_ru: Друзья планируют сюрприз ко дню рождения коллеги, но возникают неожиданные сложности.
text:
Lena: Okay, everyone, listen up. Gabriel's birthday is on Friday, and he must not suspect a thing.

Ravi: So what's the plan? I was told that you had booked the café on Willow Street.

Lena: I had, but this morning the owner called to say that the kitchen was closed because of a burst pipe. We have to find somewhere else.

Tara: What about my flat? It's small, but it's cosy, and nobody would expect it.

Lena: Brilliant. How many people are coming?

Ravi: About fifteen, I think. Gabriel's sister has promised to bring his old school friends.

Tara: Fifteen? We'll be packed like sardines! I suppose we could open the balcony door, though.

Lena: Fine. Now, how do we get Gabriel there without spoiling the surprise? He's very clever, and he reads people's faces like a book.

Ravi: I could say that I need help moving a sofa. He never says no to a friend.

Lena: Good, but he'll ask questions if you call him at the last minute. Tell him on Thursday, and remind him on Friday afternoon.

Tara: And what about the cake? Last year he said that he would never eat chocolate again.

Lena: He was joking. He ate half of mine! I've ordered a lemon cake from the bakery next to the station. It will be delivered at six.

Ravi: What if he arrives earlier than expected?

Lena: Then we'll improvise. Tara, you'll stand at the window and send us a message as soon as you see him.

Tara: Understood. Should we hide in the kitchen, or behind the sofa?

Lena: Behind the sofa is better, but please don't giggle. Last time somebody sneezed, and the whole plan fell apart.

Ravi: That was my cat's fault, I swear.

Lena: Whatever you say. Right, let's make this the best surprise he has ever had.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите губы вперёд, как для «у», и быстро раскройте их; зубы не касаются губы, иначе получится «в».
Верхние зубы касаются нижней губы, голос включён; не оглушайте звук в конце слова.
Начинайте с округлённого «о» и скользите к «и»; не сокращайте до простого «ой» с резким концом.
Кончик языка не касается нёба и не вибрирует; оттяните язык назад и слегка округлите губы.
